name: 70737 · Gonzales, LA
findings: ZIP 70737 (Gonzales) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70737 (Gonzales) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70737 (Gonzales) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
